# LEIMAI (Guangzhou Leimai Machinery Equipment Co., Ltd.)

> Manufacturer of blister packaging machines, V-fold snap-open card packaging machines, single-dose mouthwash & hair mask cup filling lines, thermal-cast hydrogel eye patch machines, NJP hard capsule filling machines, rotary tablet & bath bomb presses, 3,000-mesh cryogenic superfine mills, and turnkey secondary cartoning/overwrapping lines.
